title: SummarizeDisclosureText
description: A short summary, about a tweet long, of one free-text field of a disclosure (e.g. a lobbying registrant's goals), in the source language and machine-translated into the other EU languages, emitted by the translation service. Keyed and applied as TranslateDisclosureText is.

field.description: The UpsertDisclosure details key the text is, e.g. 'goals' (stored as detail_goals). A sink builds property names from it.

text.description: The source text that was summarised.

source_lang.description: ISO 639-1 code of the source text's language, or 'und' when nobody could tell.

source_lang_origin.description: Where source_lang came from: 'stated' by the source, 'detected' from the text by a model (see detected_by), or 'unknown'.

detected_by.description: The model that detected source_lang, when source_lang_origin is 'detected'.

summaries.description: ISO 639-1 code -> summary. The source language's own summary included; the others are its machine translations.
